name: Stonebrow
description: Trapped under rubble, he enlists in the city guard and later fights at Averru.

description_citations.text: "Scourge (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids is injured commanding Cabal forces, used by Akroma, then serves Stonebrow before escaping to rejoin the Cabal.
timeline.quote: She eventually managed to escape and rejoin the Cabal.

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl meditates in Krosa for a year until Stonebrow revives him with the Soul Reaper.
timeline.quote: Green energy flowed from Soul Reaper to Kamahl, who was revitalized

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl mutates the Krosan centaurs into powerful beasts and forms an army under Stonebrow.
timeline.quote: Their leader Bron is renamed Stonebrow and becomes Kamahl's general.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow's assassination attempt is foiled and he is converted to Akroma's cause; she then dives into a portal to confront the deathwurm.
timeline.quote: she jumped into the portal to confront her master

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Queen of Topos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fugitives from the defeated army settle an abandoned city under Zagorka and Stonebrow and name it Sanctum.
timeline.quote: Under the leadership of Zagorka and Stonebrow , they rebuild their lives and call the city Sanctum .

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage sways Sanctum for the Cabal, and Akroma declares war on the Cabal and learns Phage is meant to bear the reincarnation of the Cabal god Kuberr.
timeline.quote: to be the mother of the reincarnation of the Cabal god, Kuberr .

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow tries to kill Akroma, is brainwashed to worship Ixidor, and then leads Topos in war on Sanctum when Akroma vanishes after the deathwurm.
timeline.quote: He becomes the angel's obedient servant.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma and Phage battle until Stonebrow injures them both; Phage flees to give birth.
timeline.quote: Phage, wounded and weakened by pregnancy, flees to give birth.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stonebrow and Zagorka rediscover the city after the Nightmare War; Zagorka names it Sanctum and welcomes settlers.

citation.text: "Averru", section "Reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona encases the Numena in stone; Kuberr suffocates and Lowallyn is freed, then stomped to death by his own magma giant under Karona's control.
timeline.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated

citation.text: "Averru", section "Karona's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl swings the Soul Reaper in Sanctum, killing Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona.
timeline.quote: the axe claimed Phage and Akroma's lives, as well as an unexpected third life

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage's reanimated Cabal army is admitted; the Krosans led by Stonebrow and Kamahl smash their way in against the Glyphs.
timeline.quote: smashing the Glyphs as they galloped to the center of the struggle

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl charges in on Stonebrow and hurls Soul Reaper to slay both; Zagorka leaps from a tower to stop it.
timeline.quote: hurled herself from a tower, hoping to stop the inevitable

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona returns with an army and overcomes the defenders at Averru, killing the numena and taking the Mirari sword.
timeline.quote: The numena are killed, and only Kamahl stands with the Mirari sword.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Riding upon the mighty centaur Stonebrow

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Akroma". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Braids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Kamahl's friend who revives him from meditation and travels the world with him after the wars.

pages_say.description: A centaur who co-leads Sanctum, is brainwashed by Akroma, then recovers and persuades Kamahl to intervene.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A centaur leader renamed Stonebrow, who becomes Kamahl's general after mutation.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Centaur leading the Krosans with Kamahl and carrying him into battle.
